name: Fabric-like Visualization of Tensor Field Data
definition: A multi-pass rendering technique to visualize tensor field data on arbitrary, non-self-intersecting surfaces in image space. It uses a fabric metaphor where the two eigendirections in the plane are illustrated as thread-like structures, providing continuous visualization of salient features.
summary: Fabric-like visualization renders symmetric tensor fields on surfaces by mapping eigendirections as thread-like structures using smooth reaction-diffusion noise, avoiding explicit parameterization.
